title: Runtime D: Anthropic's Claude through the Airline Connector
lede: Claude reaches the same Airline Connector as Meta's Muse (runtime B). Only who adds it, how it gets a client ID, and who calls /mcp differ. Not tried yet: claude.ai must be added to the allowed callback hosts first.

steps.title: Ready to use
steps.what: The company has already added the connector: Owner: Organization settings > Connectors > Add > Custom > Web, URL https://muse.ai-demo.ping-devops.com/mcp; or a listing in the Connectors Directory.
steps.why: Members then only click Connect. Nobody types a URL or client ID.

steps.title: Ask
steps.what: Sam asks Claude: "How many airline points do I have?".

steps.title: Call, no token
steps.what: Claude picks loyalty_balance from the Airline Connector and calls /mcp. It has no token yet.
steps.why: The model chooses from the tool names and descriptions. The airline's name in them is what steers it.

steps.title: 401, sign in
steps.what: /mcp answers 401 with metadata: sign in at /connector/authorize, PKCE S256, scope mcp.
steps.why: Claude learns where to sign in from the server, not from config.

steps.title: Authorize
steps.what: Claude registers itself at /connector/register, then sends Sam to /connector/authorize. Muse starts the PingOne sign-in.
steps.why: Muse issues a public client (no secret) for that callback. The Owner can paste a client ID in Advanced settings instead.

steps.title: Protect check
steps.what: PingOne runs the DaVinci flow: password, Protect risk, MFA on medium risk. Protect rates the connector sign-in an agent.
steps.why: The agent is recognised by PingOne, not by its own word. The screen must say how it knows.

steps.title: Consent
steps.what: PingOne shows the "AI agent detected" screen, then asks Sam to let Claude act for him. Sam agrees.
steps.why: No consent, no token: a "no" ends the flow with nothing issued.

steps.title: Exchanges, token
steps.what: Muse does the exchanges with PingOne and gives Claude its own access token at /connector/token.
steps.why: The PingOne token never leaves Muse. Claude holds only a Muse token for scope mcp.

steps.title: Call with token
steps.what: Anthropic's servers call /mcp with that token. Muse calls the gateway, which checks the delegated token, and the points come back.
steps.why: Not tried yet: claude.ai must be added to the allowed callback hosts first.
